sources.title: Burkina Faso travel information
sources.publisher: Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Sweden
sources.officialityEvidence: Sweden's official overseas service publishes this Swedish-citizen entry guidance; the country page was last updated 20 December 2025.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visum kan även erhållas på flygplatsen i Burkina Faso till en kostnad av ca 1500 SEK.

sources.title: Chad travel information
sources.publisher: Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Sweden
sources.officialityEvidence: Sweden's official overseas service publishes this current Swedish-citizen entry guidance; the page was updated 1 July 2026.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Ansökan om visering kan göras vid Tchads ambassad i Berlin.

sources.title: Republic of the Congo entry and exit rules
sources.publisher: Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Sweden
sources.officialityEvidence: Sweden's official overseas service publishes this Swedish-citizen entry page, updated 5 March 2026, and names the issuing mission.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Ansökan om visering görs vid Republiken Kongos ambassad i Stockholm.

sources.title: Djibouti entry and exit rules
sources.publisher: Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Sweden
sources.officialityEvidence: Sweden's official overseas service publishes this current pre-travel eVisa guidance and links Djibouti's government portal; it was updated 1 July 2026.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Vid inresa i Djibouti krävs det att resenärer har ansökt om visering på förhand. Djibouti har ett system med e-visering.

sources.title: Mali entry and exit rules
sources.publisher: Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Sweden
sources.officialityEvidence: Sweden's official overseas service says Swedish travelers must lodge and collect the visa at Mali's Berlin embassy; the entry subpage was updated 20 December 2025.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visum utfärdas av Malis ambassad i Berlin där ansökan måste lämnas in och hämtas upp personligen i Berlin.

sources.title: South Sudan travel information
sources.publisher: Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Sweden
sources.officialityEvidence: Sweden's official overseas service specifically directs Swedish citizens to apply through South Sudan's Oslo embassy before entry; the answer was current in July 2026.
sources.supportingExcerpt: behöver visum som söks på Sydsudans ambassad i Oslo före inresa.

sources.title: Sudan travel information
sources.publisher: Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Sweden
sources.officialityEvidence: Sweden's official overseas service expressly says the Sudan visa is obtained at Sudan's embassy in Sweden before departure; the live page was current in August 2026.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Svenska medborgare behöver visum som i Sverige söks på Sudans ambassad före avresa.

sources.title: Syria entry and exit rules
sources.publisher: Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Sweden
sources.officialityEvidence: Sweden's official overseas service directs visa applicants to Syria's Stockholm embassy on its current entry page; the parent guidance was updated 12 August 2026.
sources.supportingExcerpt: För inresa i Syrien krävs visum och för ansökningsformulär och övrig information hänvisas till Syriens ambassad i Stockholm.

policies.title: Swedish ordinary passports can receive a Burkina Faso visa on arrival
policies.summary: Sweden's country guidance expressly says the Burkina Faso visa can be obtained at the airport.
conditions: Ordinary Swedish passport and short visitor travel.
The guidance also describes advance embassy issuance; the airport route is the easier baseline option.
The source was last updated 20 December 2025 and should receive an early recheck.

policies.title: Swedish ordinary passports require a Chad consular visa
policies.summary: Sweden directs Swedish tourist and business visitors to apply at Chad's embassy in Berlin before travel.
conditions: Ordinary Swedish passport and short tourist or business travel.
Apply through Chad's embassy in Berlin before travel.

policies.title: Swedish ordinary passports require a Republic of the Congo consular visa
policies.summary: Sweden says Swedish citizens apply for the Republic of the Congo visa at its embassy in Stockholm.
conditions: Ordinary Swedish passport and short visitor travel.
Apply through the Republic of the Congo embassy in Stockholm before travel.

policies.title: Swedish ordinary passports use Djibouti's eVisa
policies.summary: Sweden says the visa must be obtained before travel through Djibouti's eVisa system.
conditions: Ordinary Swedish passport and short visitor travel.
Apply through Djibouti's official eVisa system before travel.

application.label: Djibouti eVisa
steps: Complete the online application before travel.
Carry the approved electronic visa for entry checks.

policies.title: Swedish ordinary passports require a Mali consular visa
policies.summary: Sweden says the visa must be lodged and collected personally at Mali's Berlin embassy and cannot be obtained at Bamako airport.
conditions: Ordinary Swedish passport and short visitor travel.
Apply and collect the visa personally at Mali's embassy in Berlin before travel.
The entry subpage was last updated 20 December 2025 and should receive an early recheck.

policies.title: Swedish ordinary passports require a South Sudan consular visa
policies.summary: Sweden specifically directs Swedish citizens to apply through South Sudan's Oslo embassy before entry.
conditions: Ordinary Swedish passport and short visitor travel.
Apply through South Sudan's embassy in Oslo before travel.
Recheck early because South Sudan also operates an official eVisa portal and eligibility can change.

policies.title: Swedish ordinary passports require a Sudan consular visa
policies.summary: Sweden says Swedish citizens apply at Sudan's embassy in Sweden before departure.
conditions: Ordinary Swedish passport and short visitor travel.
Apply at Sudan's embassy before departure; operational entry remains subject to the conflict situation.

policies.title: Swedish ordinary passports require a Syrian consular visa
policies.summary: Sweden directs Swedish applicants to Syria's embassy in Stockholm for the visa application and current requirements.
conditions: Ordinary Swedish passport and short visitor travel.
Apply through Syria's embassy in Stockholm before travel; operating rules may change at short notice.

Current Swedish guidance directs applicants to Syria's Stockholm embassy rather than an electronic visa route.
